course_name_original: Science, Technology and Humanity: Opportunities and Risks
course_name_en: Science, Technology and Humanity: Opportunities and Risks

learning_outcomes.text: The students will gain awareness of the contemporary and potential future challenges posed by scientific and technological innovations and their impact on human behaviour, culture and society.

syllabus_topics: Big data: privacy, politics and power
Internet of things, it usefulness and threats
Assistant AI and its place in future society
Enhancements and human rights and the right to change self and others
Hybridization between species and between AI and organic minds
assessment_rules: To achieve an A, 90% is needed, for B at least 80%, for C 70%, for D, 60% and for an E, at least 50% of overall assessment. The final evaluation has a weight of 60%.
